name: Bright Snap Cut
oneLine: Noon-bright toy-town look cut on every phrase (~0.7 s shots), every shot drifting, small white pop captions with one red word.
bestFor: Fast 45-55 s wish-fulfilment and power stories, montages of many people/creatures, bright daytime towns; also night horror with the same cutting.
brightness: mean luma 135-155 of 255 (measured 131-154 daylight; 110 night). Calibrated on our town square: 147.0 at exposure 0.0
saturation: HSV mean 0.30-0.42 (measured 0.29-0.41); calibrated on our scene: 0.349; vivid pixels ~5-8%
camera: 85-90% of shots move at constant speed: push 42-60%, pull 31-42%, slide ~15%; 16-22%/s zoom, 170-205 px/s drift; cut mid-motion; whip-in on frame 0; crash push-in + micro-shake on shocks; 26/35/50/85 mm
characters: Blocky Roblox-style avatars with rounded block heads and flat face decals (line decals wide, comic punch faces close); faces swap per shot; realistic creatures; see CHARACTERS.md
textures: Smooth plastic skin, printed 2D clothing with subtle weave, glossy mesh hair, clean Roblox-style materials (plaster, stone, wood grain, brick, grass); no toon outlines, no grain
animation: Snappy game emotes (key poses every 6-12 f, linear), held poses under moving camera, desynced crowds, power tints, particles; no lip sync, no freeze frames
captions: Montserrat ExtraBold caps, white, 5 px black outline, cap height 30-40 px, baseline at 66-74% height, whole phrase (3-7 words), spring pop 45->118->90->100% over 9 f, swell+shrink out, caption leads the picture cut by 1-2 f, one keyword coloured by meaning: red #E0262A danger/result, power colour for the power word, yellow #F2D33A playful
sound: Single calm narrator 3.8-4.0 w/s; strong whoosh/impact transients 20-24 per minute, 82-88% on cuts (about 1 cut in 4); their soft bed (~4-5 dB under voice, steady bass) is OFF by default (Bible rule) unless Jake enables it
overrides: Look: HSV 0.55-0.65 deep colour -> 0.30-0.42 at brightness 135-155, midday
Banned flat daylight -> bright midday allowed (haze still banned)
Frame 0 title picture -> whip-in blur + first caption, no title
Steady opening then one glide -> cuts all the way, ~0.7 s shots
No whips/swings/snaps/shake -> allowed only as T3, T4, T6, T7, T11, T15 at catalogue sizes
Opening shots 1.2-3 s with eased moves -> 0.4-1.2 s, linear moves cut mid-motion
Foreground in most shots -> only in OTS/through-glass shots
House caption look -> small white outlined pop captions with one coloured keyword
keeps: Cast v2 / locked cast, rounded heads
no music bed unless Jake enables
quality checklist (note T7/T13/T14 frames in notes.json)
